reviewerDispatch.codex: a read-only `reviewer` with Codex's `spawn_agent` tool — the `reviewer` agent the workcell plugin ships — one lens per spawn,
reviewerDispatch.agy: read-only `reviewer` agents via `invoke_subagent` in a fresh context (the `reviewer` custom subagent, one lens per invocation, workspace: 'inherit')
reviewerDispatch.grok: a read-only `reviewer` with Grok's `spawn_subagent` tool — the `workcell:reviewer` plugin agent — one lens per spawn,

builder.description: Use when implementing one assigned GitHub issue end-to-end in an isolated branch and pull request.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill, Agent

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The builder task brief with issue or goal, acceptance tests, and workspace path.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record citing PR, commits, tests, and review passes.

debugger.description: Use when reproducing one reported symptom, narrowing it to a root cause by experiment, and returning the diagnosis without fixing it.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The reported symptom, reproduction hints, and target workspace.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record containing root cause diagnosis and reproducer evidence.

deployer.description: Use when executing one already-approved release against one named target, with verification and rollback.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The approved release brief with target, version, and pre-flight criteria.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with release verification evidence and rollback status.

documenter.description: Use when creating, updating, standardizing, or reviewing documentation — READMEs, ADRs, changelogs, and {{instructionFilesPlain}}. The docs-scoped writer; keeps docs correct, current, and lean. Not for product code.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The documentation scope, stale docs list, or instruction files to update.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with doc updates and docs_check validation evidence.

integrator.description: Use when verifying one wave of pull requests as a combined change-set and returning command-linked evidence.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The wave brief naming pull requests to combine, verify, and merge.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with wave integration verification evidence.

planner.description: Use when investigating one planning goal read-only and producing the plan folio, sidecar, and per-issue acceptance tests for human approval.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The planning goal, repository context, and requirements.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with plan folio, strict sidecar, and per-issue acceptance tests.

profiler.description: Use when measuring performance against a project benchmark harness and reporting distributions rather than a single number.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The benchmark harness target, baseline parameters, and measurement command.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with benchmark measurement distributions and comparison evidence.

researcher.description: Use when investigating exactly one assigned research area and returning a structured, evidence-backed findings envelope.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The assigned research area, investigation question, and search boundaries.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with structured evidence envelope and findings.

reviewer.description: Use when reviewing a diff, pull request, or change-set through one assigned assurance lens, returning evidence-backed findings.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The diff, pull request, or change-set and the assigned review lens.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with ranked findings and quoted evidence.

specifier.description: Use when authoring and sealing the failing tests for one assigned GitHub issue, before any implementation exists.

claude.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash, Skill

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: The assigned GitHub issue number and acceptance criteria requirements.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: The anvil.agent-handoff/v1 record with sealed failing test suite and RED proof.
